metadata.description: Autonomous workflow plugins for GitHub Projects V2

plugins.name: ralph
plugins.description: The naive hero picks tickets, does their best work, and moves on. 9 fat skills with flat-sibling references, hooks-enforced state, and MCP-driven artifacts over a GitHub Projects V2 board.

plugins.name: ralph-knowledge
plugins.description: Knowledge graph for ralph: semantic search, relationship traversal, and document indexing across thoughts/ documents. Optional companion to the ralph plugin.

plugins.name: ralph-demo
plugins.description: Generate sprint demo videos from structured JSON input using Remotion. 7 scene templates, pluggable themes, and export presets for 16:9, 1:1, and 9:16 formats.

plugins.name: ralph-playwright
plugins.description: Polymorphic UI testing plugin: story generation, E2E execution, a11y scanning, Storybook integration, and visual regression. Companion to the ralph plugin.
